name: @epoch/adapter-s3-object-store
description: Epoch S3-compatible object-store adapter (W051, ACR-006) — the implementation of the frozen @epoch/object-storage ObjectStore SPI (put/get/has/list/size) over ANY S3-compatible endpoint (Cloudflare R2 is the production target; AWS S3/MinIO/B2 work by endpoint change). AWS SigV4 request signing implemented with node:crypto + the platform fetch (ZERO new dependencies). Digest addressing stays authoritative in the SPI (digests are recomputed server-side; claimed digests are never trusted; retrieval is digest-verified). Layout: bytes at objects/<sha256>, neutral metadata sidecars at meta/<sha256>.json (S3 listings do not return user metadata; the sidecar is the single metadata source). Infrastructure failures return the typed 'unavailable' error code (W051 additive seam) — never raw provider errors, never thrown. R2 stores BYTES ONLY, never semantic truth (architecture lock, ACR-006).
